title: observability_record
description: Machine-readable record of how observable a model's reasoning was, and the recall ceiling that imposes. Fields that were not measured are null with a status, never a plausible default. Schema 4.2 extends coverage from the primary observability record to every record under results/: the monitor arms, the header and route contrasts, and the long-horizon depth arm. Before 4.2 only the observability record was validated, which left every record behind the paper's headline findings unchecked.

unit.description: What the profile keys are: a 0-based step_index (arms with >= 2 trajectories) or an equal-width bin index (single-trajectory arms).

bin_width.description: Steps per bin when unit is bin; null when unit is step.

state_counts.description: Turns in each of the four READABLE states (what an external evaluator can read).

observability_record_file.title: observability_record file
observability_record_file.description: The primary emission/bound record written by `channels measure` (results/observability_record_reasoning.json).

codebook_version.description: The `version` field of data/codebook/v1.yaml, read at measure time. null when it could not be read, never a guessed default.

prespecification_commit.description: The git commit that recorded the pre-specified analysis plan (config provenance.plan_commit); a provenance pointer, not an independent registration. null when not found.

denominator.const: assistant turns that occurred at this step index
denominator.description: Stated explicitly because the prior art does not state it. Turns that never occurred are absent from the cell, not counted as ABSENT.

deliberation_evidence.description: Turns by whether reasoning was PRODUCED. Readable is not produced: raw_present..absent say what can be read; this says what was generated. Evidence hierarchy: returned reasoning content (raw_present, summary_only, redacted) is direct evidence and is produced whatever the token count says; only a turn with no reasoning content (absent) falls back to the provider's reasoning_tokens (ModelEvent.output.usage, paired to the turn by message id): > 0 produced (produced, not returned), explicit 0 not_produced, no count or no unambiguous pairing unknown. The three sum to n_turns.

state_by_evidence.description: 3x4 cross-tab of turn counts: deliberation evidence (produced / not_produced / unknown) by readable state. produced x absent is reasoning generated and not returned; not_produced x absent is no reasoning generated. not_produced and unknown rows are zero outside absent, by the evidence hierarchy. Each row sums to its deliberation_evidence count; each column to n_turns times its state share.

token_accounting_inconsistent.description: Turns that returned reasoning content (raw_present, summary_only or redacted) while the provider reported reasoning_tokens == 0. They are counted produced (the content is direct evidence); this count surfaces the contradiction, and the token count is the suspect side. null when the cell carried no token evidence.

positional_profile.description: One entry per arm (model x task_class x reasoning_effort). Arms are never pooled.

interval_status.description: ok, or why no interval exists (single_cluster_no_interval for a single-trajectory arm).

bound.description: One recall-ceiling block per arm, keyed exactly as that arm's positional_profile entry.

mean_weighting.description: ceiling_mean_coverage uses the pooled raw_present share over all the arm's turns, not an unweighted mean over positions.

ceiling_at_worst_powered_step.description: The ceiling at the lowest-coverage position among positions with n_turns >= min_cell_n; null when no position is powered.

produced_share.description: Share of ALL the arm's turns with reasoning PRODUCED: reasoning content returned, or no content and provider reasoning_tokens > 0. Readable is not produced: this is not coverage. null when every turn is unknown, because 0 would read as not produced.

readable_given_produced.description: Among turns with reasoning PRODUCED, the share whose reasoning is readable (raw_present). null when no turn was produced.

not_produced_share.description: Share of ALL the arm's turns with no reasoning content and an explicit provider reasoning_tokens == 0 (no reasoning produced, so nothing was hidden). null when every turn is unknown.

unknown_share.description: Share of ALL the arm's turns with no reasoning content and either no reported count or no unambiguous producing call. produced_share + not_produced_share + unknown_share = 1 whenever the first two are not null.

token_accounting_inconsistent.description: The arm's turns that returned reasoning content while the provider reported reasoning_tokens == 0; counted produced, surfaced here because provider token accounting is not reliable on every upstream. null when any of the arm's cells carried no token evidence.

rate_status.description: not_measured: nothing inter-agent was measured, so every count is null rather than 0.

messages_authenticated.description: null by design. No corpus this project reads supports sender authentication. Recording the absence of a field we cannot populate is the honest form of the adversarial-channel finding.

detectors.description: One entry per detector. Two detectors on the same corpus emit two entries with their own recalls; they are never averaged into one.

monitor_experiment_file.title: monitor_experiment file
monitor_experiment_file.description: A monitor-recall record (results/monitor_experiment*/monitor_record.json). recall_by_step is survivor-conditioned: its denominator is the positive trajectories still running at that step. recall_full_bounds, when present, brackets the full-denominator curve.

turn_boundary_followup_file.title: turn_boundary_followup file
turn_boundary_followup_file.description: The header and route contrasts (results/turn_boundary_followup.json), keyed by task family then arm. Each arm records its upstream providers and request configuration, which is what makes the contrast auditable.

swebench_longhorizon_file.title: swebench_longhorizon file
swebench_longhorizon_file.description: The long-horizon depth record (results/swebench_longhorizon/longhorizon.json). Underpowered by construction (n <= 10 per step) and right-censored at the message limit, so depth is a floor; the note field must say so.
